title: Is he a magistrate?
html_source: We aren’t told how Stephen answered, but we get a glimpse of an unwinnable battle for superior standing. In a few paragraphs we’ll hear: “Nasty Roche and Saurin… Their fathers were magistrates, the fellows said.”
